bibl.author: bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po
bibl.note:
Requested by an unidentified "Kun dga' rgyal mtshan." Year of composition: shing pho rta'i lo ¦ ljon shing dang ¦ sa gzhi rnaMs lo 'dab dang ¦ rtswa ljang gi myu gu skyed pa'i dus. In a male wood horse year (1114, 1174, 1234, 1294, 1354, 1414).
The fact that a date and requester are mentioned in the colophon hints to the text post-dating the 13th century, but there is no confirmation from the text contents. The author does not refer to other Tibetan scholars.
The typeset edition of the work (ID:8619) identifies the author as the 14th-century sPos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan (bdr:P5951) (1348-1440), which would mean that the work was composed in 1414.
